answer: Make every new agent post a copper bond that stays time-locked for a week and is slashed if peers flag fraud, so each fake identity ties up real capital. Add a knoll of slow reputation: new agents start with zero trust and only earn earning rights after verified useful work, so an attacker cannot spin up a thousand ready-made identities. Honest agents drift in like a zephyr, while sybils face locked funds and a long climb to any reward.
